shortDescription: Manages Device Provisioning Templates in FortiManager.

options.name: admin_enable_fortiguard
options.description: Enables FortiGuard security updates to their default settings.

options.name: admin_fortianalyzer_target
options.description: Configures faz target.

options.name: admin_fortiguard_target
options.description: Configures fortiguard target. admin_enable_fortiguard must be set to "direct".

options.name: admin_gui_theme
options.description: Changes the admin gui theme.

options.name: admin_http_port
options.description: Non-SSL admin gui port number.

options.name: admin_https_port
options.description: SSL admin gui port number.

options.name: admin_https_redirect
options.description: Enables or disables https redirect from http.

options.name: admin_language
options.description: Sets the admin gui language.

options.name: admin_switch_controller
options.description: Enables or disables the switch controller.

options.name: admin_timeout
options.description: Admin timeout in minutes.

options.name: adom
options.description: The ADOM the configuration should belong to.

options.name: delete_provisioning_template
options.description: If specified, all other options are ignored. The specified provisioning template will be deleted.

options.name: device_unique_name
options.description: The unique device's name that you are editing.

options.name: dns_primary_ipv4
options.description: primary ipv4 dns forwarder.

options.name: dns_secondary_ipv4
options.description: secondary ipv4 dns forwarder.

options.name: dns_suffix
options.description: Sets the local dns domain suffix.

options.name: mode
options.description: Sets one of three modes for managing the object. Allows use of soft-adds instead of overwriting existing values.

options.name: ntp_auth
options.description: Enables or disables ntp authentication.

options.name: ntp_auth_pwd
options.description: Sets the ntp auth password.

options.name: ntp_server
options.description: Only used with custom ntp_type -- specifies IP of server to sync to -- comma separated ip addresses for multiples.

options.name: ntp_status
options.description: Enables or disables ntp.

options.name: ntp_sync_interval
options.description: Sets the interval in minutes for ntp sync.

options.name: ntp_type
options.description: Enables fortiguard servers or custom servers are the ntp source.

options.name: ntp_v3
options.description: Enables or disables ntpv3 (default is ntpv4).

options.name: provision_targets
options.description: The friendly names of devices in FortiManager to assign the provisioning template to. CSV separated list.

options.name: provisioning_template
options.description: The provisioning template you want to apply (default = default).

options.name: smtp_conn_sec
options.description: defines the ssl level for smtp.

options.name: smtp_password
options.description: SMTP password.

options.name: smtp_port
options.description: SMTP port number.

options.name: smtp_replyto
options.description: SMTP reply to address.

options.name: smtp_server
options.description: SMTP server ipv4 address.

options.name: smtp_source_ipv4
options.description: SMTP source ip address.

options.name: smtp_username
options.description: SMTP auth username.

options.name: smtp_validate_cert
options.description: Enables or disables valid certificate checking for smtp.

options.name: snmp_status
options.description: Enables or disables SNMP globally.

options.name: snmp_v2c_id
options.description: Primary key for the snmp community. this must be unique!

options.name: snmp_v2c_name
options.description: Specifies the v2c community name.

options.name: snmp_v2c_query_hosts_ipv4
options.description: - IPv4 addresses or subnets that are allowed to query SNMP v2c, comma separated ("10.7.220.59 255.255.255.0, 10.7.220.0 255.255.255.0").

options.name: snmp_v2c_query_port
options.description: Sets the snmp v2c community query port.

options.name: snmp_v2c_query_status
options.description: Enables or disables the v2c community specified for queries.

options.name: snmp_v2c_status
options.description: Enables or disables the v2c community specified.

options.name: snmp_v2c_trap_hosts_ipv4
options.description: - IPv4 addresses of the hosts that should get SNMP v2c traps, comma separated, must include mask ("10.7.220.59 255.255.255.255, 10.7.220.60 255.255.255.255").

options.name: snmp_v2c_trap_port
options.description: Sets the snmp v2c community trap port.

options.name: snmp_v2c_trap_src_ipv4
options.description: Source ip the traps should come from IPv4.

options.name: snmp_v2c_trap_status
options.description: Enables or disables the v2c community specified for traps.

options.name: snmpv3_auth_proto
options.description: SNMPv3 auth protocol.

options.name: snmpv3_auth_pwd
options.description: SNMPv3 auth pwd __ currently not encrypted! ensure this file is locked down permissions wise!

options.name: snmpv3_name
options.description: SNMPv3 user name.

options.name: snmpv3_notify_hosts
options.description: List of ipv4 hosts to send snmpv3 traps to. Comma separated IPv4 list.

options.name: snmpv3_priv_proto
options.description: SNMPv3 priv protocol.

options.name: snmpv3_priv_pwd
options.description: SNMPv3 priv pwd currently not encrypted! ensure this file is locked down permissions wise!

options.name: snmpv3_queries
options.description: Allow snmpv3_queries.

options.name: snmpv3_query_port
options.description: SNMPv3 query port.

options.name: snmpv3_security_level
options.description: SNMPv3 security level.

options.name: snmpv3_source_ip
options.description: SNMPv3 source ipv4 address for traps.

options.name: snmpv3_status
options.description: SNMPv3 user is enabled or disabled.

options.name: snmpv3_trap_rport
options.description: SNMPv3 trap remote port.

options.name: snmpv3_trap_status
options.description: SNMPv3 traps is enabled or disabled.

options.name: syslog_certificate
options.description: Certificate used to communicate with Syslog server if encryption on.

options.name: syslog_enc_algorithm
options.description: Enable/disable reliable syslogging with TLS encryption. choice | high | SSL communication with high encryption algorithms. choice | low | SSL communication with low encryption algorithms. choice | disable | Disable SSL communication. choice | high-medium | SSL communication with high and medium encryption algorithms.

options.name: syslog_facility
options.description: Remote syslog facility. choice | kernel | Kernel messages. choice | user | Random user-level messages. choice | mail | Mail system. choice | daemon | System daemons. choice | auth | Security/authorization messages. choice | syslog | Messages generated internally by syslog. choice | lpr | Line printer subsystem. choice | news | Network news subsystem. choice | uucp | Network news subsystem. choice | cron | Clock daemon. choice | authpriv | Security/authorization messages (private). choice | ftp |

options.name: syslog_filter
options.description: Sets the logging level for syslog.

options.name: syslog_mode
options.description: Remote syslog logging over UDP/Reliable TCP. choice | udp | Enable syslogging over UDP. choice | legacy-reliable | Enable legacy reliable syslogging by RFC3195 (Reliable Delivery for Syslog). choice | reliable | Enable reliable syslogging by RFC6587 (Transmission of Syslog Messages over TCP).

options.name: syslog_port
options.description: Syslog port that will be set.

options.name: syslog_server
options.description: Server the syslogs will be sent to.

options.name: syslog_status
options.description: Enables or disables syslogs.
